title: Lesson: Figure ordering in DOCX must match manuscript narrative
notes: Bug found 2026-07-27: Figures 6 and 7 were placed AFTER Figure 8 in master DOCX.
Root cause: figures were appended in wrong sequence during build_clean_publication_figures.py docx assembly.
Fix: moved Fig6 (body idx 233-234) and Fig7 (body idx 258-259) to body positions 158-161 (before Fig8).
Final verified order: Fig1, Fig2, Fig3, Fig4, Fig5, Fig6, Fig7, Fig8.
RULE: When assembling multi-figure DOCX, always append image+caption blocks in ascending figure number. Never in code generation order.
